name: deployment
description: Manage deployment: get/cancel/list_for_app/rollback_images/rollback. For rollback actions uuid is the application UUID; rollback requires a commit/tag returned by rollback_images. Logs are excluded by default — for get use lines (paginated tail), for list_for_app use include_logs=true.

commit.description: rollback only: image commit/tag from rollback_images
